description:
Easy 2 TC build order and tips for the mid and late game.

Check my other tughlaq guides:
- FC: https://aoe4guides.com/edit/cQ9LjFfmsY5XCVtfhXQS
name: Tughlaq | 2TC
author: Jockxtar

notes: Make 1 @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ and send it to scout for @resource/sheep.webp@ around @resource/resource_gold.webp@
When @building_economy/house.webp@ is about to finish, position second @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ near @resource/resource_gold.webp@
@landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@: Is better for the late game but barely noticeable in the early game. Strong but risky.

@landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.webp@: @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ on @age/age_2.webp@ are super strong, specially in the first few minutes of the game. This can help us defend until we recover the investment on the @building_economy/town-center.webp@. Much safer but worse scaling.
Leave the 4 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ on @resource/resource_stone.webp@ to later build and upgrade @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@

When you get 400 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, build @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ near your two @building_economy/town-center.webp@ with at least 2 empty tiles around it to build @building_economy/house.webp@ and @building_economy/farm.webp@.

Select @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@ as the governor for this @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@. The passive @resource/resource_food.webp@ will help us fund the extra @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ production and eventually go to @age/age_3.webp@.
Prioritize upgrading it rather than building new @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@.

If the opponent is playing aggressive and forces you to make units in @age/age_2.webp@, build @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ and research the upgrades, otherwise you will soon start floating @resource/resource_gold.webp@
@landmark_delhi/house-of-learning.webp@: Offers excellent upgrades for our core units (the elephants).

@landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.webp@: Since we are already playing very greedy with the second @building_economy/town-center.webp@, focusing on building and upgrading @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ is too greedy.
During age up make sure to build another @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ and assign @ability_tughluq/uch.webp@ as its governor for the discounts on upgrades.
Gradually build @building_economy/farm.webp@ and @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ to complete your economy.
Defend with an infantry army (@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ + @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@) and raid with @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@
<- Ideal economy balance should look like this:
@building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ governors priority: @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@ (tier 3) followed by @ability_tughluq/uch.webp@ (tier 1). Then pick based on the situation:
@ability_tughluq/ajmer.webp@ if under inmediate threat or to help secure an exposed @resource/resource_gold.webp@ vein.
@ability_tughluq/sehwan.webp@ if you manage to grab some @resource/relics.webp@.
@ability_tughluq/jalor.webp@ for a stronger cavalry army. Preferably leave it for later.
@ability_tughluq/multan.webp@ if you don't need/want the others. A bit unnecessary.

@landmark_delhi/hisar-academy.webp@: Can generate up to 300 @resource/resource_food.webp@ and 300 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ per minute, which is incredibly useful for the ideal @civilization_flag/tug.webp@ army that requires a lot of @resource/resource_gold.webp@.

@landmark_delhi/palace-of-the-sultan.webp@: The only tier 4 governor effects that are worth are @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@ for more resources and @ability_tughluq/jalor.webp@ for a bit of extra health on cavalry or @ability_tughluq/sehwan.webp@ for more healing on @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@.
Since we have already built and upgraded @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@, we can discard that option.

@ability_tughluq/jalor.webp@ only grants 15 more health compared to the tier 3 effect, so it's not really worth it, although it can be useful for a timing attack right after aging up; since we are skipping the several minutes it takes to build and upgrade the @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ (and the @resource/resource_stone.webp@ cost).

@ability_tughluq/sehwan.webp@ is ok, but nothing too crazy, and adding @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ is very expensive for the stats they provide. It's good to have a few of them, but investing an entire landmark to buff them is not optimal.
<- Ideal economy balance should look like this:

when ~400 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@6 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ build @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@@ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@ next to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ & @building_economy/house.webp@ to gain @resource/resource_food.webp@

description:
Detailed guide to the Tughlaq Fort Rush DONE RIGHT by Swaggy Professor. My teammate used this Build in 2v2 and it works surprisingly well even in Team games! 

Originally uploaded by murtuk: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/Vy9fDYJHvOd8rW4nGQIw
name: The Tughlaq Fort Rush DONE RIGHT - Swaggy Professor
author: Niki45nk

notes: Use starting @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ to scout around your @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Use your @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ to search for opponent's exposed @resource/berrybush.webp@ or @resource/resource_gold.webp@

When the first @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ depletes, send all @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
When you have 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@, send all @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@
When @resource/resource_stone.webp@ vein has 790, send all @resource/resource_stone.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ to opponent's base
[Make sure the @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ is not in opponent's @building_economy/town-center.webp@ attack range]

When you have 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@, send all @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ with a @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Use @unit_tughluq/amir_warrior.webp@ to harass opponent's resources and villagers
Build 2 @building_military/archery-range.webp@ near @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ and always make @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ and @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@

@landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.webp@ with 3 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@. Remacro for 7 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@to@resource/resource_stone.webp@. When @age/age_2.webp@ completes move the 3 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@to@resource/resource_stone.webp@

Gather @resource/resource_stone.webp@ until 320 remaining so you have enough to fully upgrade @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@@ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@. Move to @resource/resource_wood.webp@@resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@

@abilities/repair.webp@@building_military/barracks.webp@/@building_military/archery-range.webp@/@building_military/stable.webp@ depending on enemy counters. Continually produce @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@.

Upgrade @technology_tughluq/elephant_economics_1.webp@ from @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@and have 1@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ build @building_economy/house.webp@ all the way around @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@
Build@building_military/barracks.webp@ with 1@resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ against french and knight civs
(if opponent goes archer get +1 ranged damage)
Move 2@resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ ->@resource/resource_food.webp@ and build farms if wood too abundant
Location depends on spawn, if safe @resource/deer.webp@, @building_economy/town-center.webp@ on @resource/deer.webp@ otherwise @building_economy/town-center.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Shift @resource/rally.webp@ them to @resource/deer.webp@ if safe, otherwise @resource/sheep.webp@

@resource/resource_stone.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ build @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@, then goes onto @resource/resource_gold.webp@ (+@unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ if @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@)

Location depends on spawn, if safe @resource/deer.webp@, @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@, otherwise @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ on @resource/deer.webp@ & once built send 10 @resource/sheep.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/deer.webp@ with 1 @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@
Make 2 @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ scout with them 1 @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ to gold after
Build @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ to opponents base - harass
@unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ what opponent builds (@building_military/barracks.webp@@building_military/archery-range.webp@@building_military/stable.webp@) counter with the other
Check what opponent built and counter @building_military/barracks.webp@@building_military/archery-range.webp@@building_military/stable.webp@
Harass with @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ making sure not to die
Start transitioning to wood and extra gold with @resource/rally.webp@

description: Feudal power spike with Healer Elephants from Dome of Faith, backed by mass Archers. Transition to Castle for instant upgrades and timing.
name: Healer Elephants + Archers Rush (5:30 Hit) - Swaggy PRofessor - simplified - copy - same as "healer elephant age 2 fight"
author: Wado321

notes: @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ scouts one flank; starting worker elephant scouts the opposite flank (they can capture @resource/sheep.webp@ as drop-off).
Immediately queue a 2nd worker elephant (this one scouts near your @resource/resource_gold.webp@ only).
First new vil → @resource/sheep.webp@. Next 3 vils will go to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ as they pop.
First gold vil builds @building_economy/house.webp@ under TC coverage (vs spear rush).
Worker elephants will bring back sheep they pass; use them to path through herds.
After 3 on gold, @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ until 9 on food.
Now set TC @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ for the rest of Feudal.
If the second worker elephant hasn’t returned yet, send wood vils to stragglers until it does, then to the woodline.
Landmark builders place @building_military/archery-range.webp@, then return to eco.
Rally army to an exposed enemy resource (gold / berries).
Every time you place a @building_economy/house.webp@, follow a 4x4 grid layout (prep for Fort aura economy later).
First timing: Healer Elephant (~500 HP) + Archers can dive short under towers/TC due to healing.
If enemy spams horsemen, add 1–2 @building_military/barracks.webp@ and produce @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ alongside archers.
Spend gold on @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ and key eco upgrades.
If short on food: go @resource/berrybush.webp@ first, then @resource/deer.webp@ once you have map control.
Send a large group to collect 425@resource/resource_stone.webp@.
Assign the Food Governor to the Fort to generate ~240 @resource/resource_food.webp@/min passively.
Shift eco toward @resource/resource_food.webp@ and @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to prepare Castle.
Keep pressure with Healer Elephants + Archers; deny deer/berries and punish over-extensions.
Age up with House of wisdom
Keep army close to enemy for immediate post-Castle timing.
Instantly research: @technology_military/wedge-rivets.webp@ , @technology_military/balanced-projectiles.webp@, Veteran Archers and House of Wisdom Upgrades.
If you added Barracks: research the Spearman training/upgrade techs as well.
Tughlaq techs complete in ~5s → hit your timing immediately with fully upgraded Castle army.
Push for game-ending fight: Healer Elephants + Veteran Archers (+ Spearmen if needed).
Keep adding @building_economy/farm.webp@ or @building_economy/house.webp@ around Fort as wood floats
